subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should OpenClaw accept the proposed breaking reshapes of the question, worker, and session-catalog protocol families as part of the pre-publication/beta compatibility window?
rationale: The code can be internally consistent while still setting a public package and beta-client contract that existing or external consumers may rely on; the protected maintainer label and stated accepted breakage require an explicit owner choice.

options.title: Approve the compatibility window
options.body: Confirm that these beta/pre-publication wire changes are intentionally allowed, contingent on adding redacted live runtime proof for the reshaped request/resolve flow.

options.title: Preserve or phase the old shapes
options.body: Keep the existing fields or introduce a documented migration/deprecation path until the public protocol direction is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the compatibility window
recommendation.body: Confirm that these beta/pre-publication wire changes are intentionally allowed, contingent on adding redacted live runtime proof for the reshaped request/resolve flow.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the active protocol proposal and has made the current-head migration across its affected consumers.
